# appleads_countries_or_regions (Data Source)

Lists supported Apple Ads countries or regions via `GET /countries-or-regions`.

Useful when validating campaign `countries_or_regions` or product-page locale coverage. This endpoint is **read-only**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appleads_countries_or_regions" "north_america" {
  countries_or_regions_filter = ["US", "CA"]
}

output "supported_us_languages" {
  value = [
    for lang in data.appleads_countries_or_regions.north_america.countries_or_regions[0].supported_languages : lang.language_code
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `countries_or_regions_filter` (List of String) Optional ISO country/region codes to filter (Apple `countriesOrRegions` query parameter).

### Read-Only

- `countries_or_regions` (Attributes List) Matching countries or regions (may be empty). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--countries_or_regions))
- `id` (String) Composite id of the filter parameters (or `all`).

<a id="nestedatt--countries_or_regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `countries_or_regions`

Read-Only:

- `country_or_region` (String) ISO country or region code, e.g. `US`.
- `default_languages` (Attributes List) Default languages for the country or region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--countries_or_regions--default_languages))
- `supported_languages` (Attributes List) Supported languages for the country or region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--countries_or_regions--supported_languages))

<a id="nestedatt--countries_or_regions--default_languages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `countries_or_regions.default_languages`

Read-Only:

- `language` (String) Language display name.
- `language_code` (String) Language code such as `en-US`.


<a id="nestedatt--countries_or_regions--supported_languages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `countries_or_regions.supported_languages`

Read-Only:

- `language` (String) Language display name.
- `language_code` (String) Language code such as `en-US`.
